title: Harmon Villa Weligama
description:
Visual Direction:

  1. Use soft gradients of sand beige + ocean teal or peach sunset tones.
  2. Blend in the HARMON swirl logo subtly in the background (faint watermark).
  3. Foreground image: A massage, spa ritual, or yoga moment (like your “front-view-woman-working-spa.jpg”).
  4. Overlay semi-transparent white or beige content box with elegant typography (Serif for title, Sans-serif for body).
